description:
Which transcript the session writes to: `transcriptId` for an existing
one, or what to start a new one with, which the session passes to
`createTranscript` the first time the software asks how to stream.

transcriptId.description:
The transcript the session writes to. Given to carry on a
transcript, after a session failed or in a reopened tab; otherwise
set when the session starts a new one. To carry on after a reload,
the page keeps this id, in sessionStorage for example, and reads
the transcript with getTranscript: one still recording or paused
can be carried on. A tab opened again has no id kept, and finds
the transcript with listTranscripts, by its subject and status:
`q=subjectId:{id} status:recording,paused`. A transcript with no
subject can't be found that way.

profileId.description: The profile to start a new transcript under.

model.description: The transcription service's model, for a new transcript. Required unless the profile's service is `none`.

client.description: The transcription software, as `name/version`, for a new transcript.

startedAt.description: When the conversation began, by the client's clock, for a new transcript.

subjectType.description: What kind of thing the transcript records, e.g. `interview` or `call`.

subjectId.description: The record of the conversation it transcribes — an interview's id, say. `subjectType` says what kind.

transcript.description: Link to the related Transcript resource.

profile.description: Link to the related TranscriptionProfile resource.
